content: Various interventions have been shown to effectively reduce diabetes-related distress and improve glycemic control, as measured by A1C levels. These interventions include cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and mindfulness-based therapy, both of which have demonstrated significant success in addressing the emotional and psychological challenges associated with diabetes management. Additionally, digital tools, such as smartphone applications, have proven to be effective platforms for delivering CBT and other therapeutic interventions. These tools provide accessible and scalable methods to help individuals manage diabetes distress and improve their overall well-being.
